people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Two hundred men went with Absalom out of Jerusalem, who were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they didn’t know anything.
translations.bsb: Two hundred men from Jerusalem accompanied Absalom. They had been invited as guests and they went along innocently, for they knew nothing about the matter.
translations.kjv: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.
translations.asv: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were invited, and went in their simplicity; and they knew not anything.
